why: In figures 1, 3, 4 and 5 the band runs slanting from one corner to the other corner. In figure 2 the band is straight across (horizontal). So figure 2 is the odd one out. The small flags move in every figure, so they do not decide the answer.
trick: Look first at the biggest part (here the band) and its direction.
